name: European Commission (Horizon Europe, Cluster 6 Farm2Fork)
program: Horizon Europe Cluster 6 topics in SALSAV scope (incl. HORIZON-CL6-2027-02-FARM2FORK-02, water-nutrient-energy nexus, FNSSA)
collect_note: Farming, water and rural research topics from the EU's Horizon Europe Cluster 6 calls for 2026 to 2027 are read from the EU funding portal twice a day, each with its next deadline. Late-added or partnership-only topics may be missed. All items wait for review before showing.

evidence: POST https://api.tech.ec.europa.eu/search-api/prod/rest/search?apiKey=SEDIA&text=*&pageSize=50 (same wire format as adapters/api.ts euFt), checked 2026-11-12. callIdentifier values that exist with open or forthcoming Cluster 6 topics: 2026-04 (1 topic, forthcoming, deadline 2026-11-26), 2027-01 (23), 2027-01-two-stage (2), 2027-02 (16), 2027-02-two-stage (2), 2027-03 (7); 2027-03-two-stage, 2028-01, 2028-03, 2027-04 return 0 and are not listed; 2028-02 and 2028-02-two-stage return 0 today and stay as watch values from the earlier config. Response size: all six calls together are 1.82 MB, over the engine's 1.5 MB read cap (http.ts MAX_READ_BYTES), which truncates the JSON and silently yields count 0. must_not drops destination 48080651 (Circular economy and biobased sectors, 12 topics, none in scope) and three zero-pollution topics (biocides, air quality planning, industrial benchmarking): 36 results, 1.27 MB. Harness 2026-11-12: ok, http 200, count 16, open 16; every item is a Cluster 6 topic, deadlines from the API (nearest future deadline). Not collected: HORIZON-CL6-2023-GOVERNANCE-01-13 (NOSTRADAMUS) is a 2023 project-level open call without a Cluster 6 callIdentifier in this API; a query term for it would pull in third-party project calls of other programmes.
edge_risk: Response is about 1.27 MB against the engine's 1.5 MB read cap; if Cluster 6 grows past the cap the read is truncated and returns zero items (min_items then flags it). Query depends on the portal's SEDIA search API, whose wire format is undocumented.
